crossRefs.note: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.
Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.
Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of…
The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.
Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.
“Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…

translations.web: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
translations.bsb: so that you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth?
translations.kjv: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
translations.asv: That against God thou turnest thy spirit, And lettest words go out of thy mouth?
